corrections.text: The article states, citing Offshore Wind, that the 2GW Caledonia project splits into '77 for Caledonia North and 78 for Caledonia South, including as many as 39 floating turbines.' That turbine breakdown does not appear in the cited Offshore Wind article; it comes from the Scottish Government's announcement, which states Caledonia North will use 'up to 77' turbines and Caledonia South 'up to 78... of which no more than 39 shall be floating.' The figures themselves are accurate — only the citation was attributed to the wrong outlet.
